lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: Once upon a time, the strongest|wizard who ever lived ruled the world.
lines.text: Once upon a time, the strongest wizard who ever lived ruled the world.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: They called him only the Master.|For a thousand years, he kept the peace.
lines.text: They called him only the Master. For a thousand years, he kept the peace.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: He raised four apprentices,|and gave each of them a kingdom.
lines.text: He raised four apprentices, and gave each of them a kingdom.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: Then, between one breath|and the next, he was gone.
lines.text: Then, between one breath and the next, he was gone.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: Four heirs. One empty throne.
lines.text: Four heirs. One empty throne.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: I loved all four of them.|And still, they went to war.
lines.text: I loved all four of them. And still, they went to war.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: Now winter has stopped their war, child,|and two of them remember how it began.
lines.text: Now winter has stopped their war, child, and two of them remember how it began.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: Vey's. He cut it off his own|sword the day I lit five beacons.
lines.text: Vey's. He cut it off his own sword the day I lit five beacons.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: But that wasn't the start. The start was a barn.
lines.text: But that wasn't the start. The start was a barn.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: I was six. It was our barn. Nobody clapped.
lines.text: I was six. It was our barn. Nobody clapped.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: Smaller, next time. And not the barn.
lines.text: Smaller, next time. And not the barn.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: Nobody had ever said "next time" to me before.
lines.text: Nobody had ever said "next time" to me before.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.subtitle: Again.
lines.text: Again.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: Vey said fire was the easy part.|I was very good at the easy part.
lines.text: Vey said fire was the easy part. I was very good at the easy part.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: I never met a wall I couldn't turn into a door.
lines.text: I never met a wall I couldn't turn into a door.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.subtitle: Vessa! Wait!
lines.text: Vessa! Wait!

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: Everyone always said wait.|Nobody ever told me what for.
lines.text: Everyone always said wait. Nobody ever told me what for.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: The Master had a saying about fire that|won't wait. He said it a lot. Mostly at me.
lines.text: The Master had a saying about fire that won't wait. He said it a lot. Mostly at me.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: Again, my joy. Smaller.
lines.text: Again, my joy. Smaller.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: He laughed when I laughed.|Nobody else ever did that.
lines.text: He laughed when I laughed. Nobody else ever did that.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: She tells it with fireworks.|Mine needs one candle.
lines.text: She tells it with fireworks. Mine needs one candle.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: My father dug the graves. I read them.|Someone had to remember who was down there.
lines.text: My father dug the graves. I read them. Someone had to remember who was down there.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: Hello, Tobin Marsh. Nobody visits you either.
lines.text: Hello, Tobin Marsh. Nobody visits you either.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: The town boys dared me into the crypt|for a night. They waited outside.
lines.text: The town boys dared me into the crypt for a night. They waited outside.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: I came out at dawn. Bored.|The shadows came out with me.
lines.text: I came out at dawn. Bored. The shadows came out with me.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: In the citadel there was always|enough. I took more anyway.
lines.text: In the citadel there was always enough. I took more anyway.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: Malrik! Where's my bread?
lines.text: Malrik! Where's my bread?

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: What bread?
lines.text: What bread?

lines.speaker: vey
lines.subtitle: He's not afraid of it. Most grown men are.
lines.text: He's not afraid of it. Most grown men are.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: I know. That is why it is his.
lines.text: I know. That is why it is his.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: He gave me the dark. What was left.|He never said otherwise.
lines.text: He gave me the dark. What was left. He never said otherwise.
